verification.title: Verification
verification.why: TezFarmo checks that every business is real before it can form partnerships. A TezFarmo administrator reviews your documents against your legal details.

explain.NOT_SUBMITTED: Upload the required documents and submit them. Until then partnerships cannot be activated; you can already set up your catalog, prices and stock.
explain.PENDING: Your documents are waiting for review by a TezFarmo administrator. This is not instant. Meanwhile you can keep working on your catalog, prices and stock; partnerships are activated after approval.
explain.APPROVED: Your organization is verified. Its legal name and tax identifier are now locked.
explain.REJECTED: Verification was rejected. Read the reason, correct your details or documents and submit again.

verification.rejectedNext: Fix what is described above, then submit new documents below.
verification.documentsHelp: PDF, JPEG or PNG, up to 10 MB each. Files are private: only your organization owner and TezFarmo administrators can open them.
verification.confirmText: Your legal name, tax identifier and address are sent with the documents and locked while the review runs.
verification.ownerOnly: Only the organization owner can submit documents for verification.

verifications.title: Verification queue
verifications.description: Check each submission against the documents and official sources before deciding. Every decision and every document opened is recorded.
verifications.manualNote: TezFarmo has no automatic registry check. Compare the legal snapshot with the documents and, where possible, with the official tax/registration register before approving.
verifications.otherReviewer: Another administrator is reviewing this request; only they can approve it.
verifications.reasonHint: At least 10 characters. The organization sees this text.
